problem_type: Domain feedback and user input must remain owned until lane admission
symptom: Production image judging returns a content deviation but the generation panel has no card; failed sends also lose typed draft.
direct_cause: The v4 shell omitted the existing shot verification consumer and cleared draft before awaiting send admission.
class_root: UI initiation was treated as execution acceptance, while domain feedback was not joined from its existing owner.
affected_population: Every generated shot with a failed verification dimension
Composer or repair sends rejected by missing skills, project binding, upload state or lane admission
internal_only_reason: Existing internal store, approved UI component and lane admission API own this invariant; no external dependency behavior changes.
invariants: Current-project verification findings render from the original domain store.
A rejected send preserves feedback, repair budget and typed draft.
Only an accepted current request consumes one existing repair round; project or verification changes invalidate late completion.
generality_proof: All visible repair initiation uses the same existing actions.send admission result; original verification store state is read directly and rechecked after the asynchronous boundary.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Join domain feedback and commit repair-budget transition only after accepted current admission.
Return admission success and clear only the unchanged current composer input after ACK.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The shell renders the original card through the feedback hook.
Both use actions.send; neither may infer acceptance merely from clicking.
The existing domain owner already checks project and request identity and owns the two-round budget.

recurrence.reason: Every low verification score and every rejected async send can reproduce the same omitted feedback or premature cleanup.
same_class_scan: Read all Shell send entry points and useAgentPanelV4Actions ACK cleanup
Read shotVerifyStore initial/live/request lifecycle and all consumeRound/markFixing consumers
Read approved wiring plan deviation mapping and complete original card

prevention.invariant: Feedback and repair budget transition only after current lane admission succeeds.
prevention.failure_mode: Rejected, failed, duplicate or stale initiation leaves original domain feedback and budget intact.
prevention.strategy: Use one domain-feedback join and one acknowledged send result, with no transcript or store duplication.

legacy_paths.rationale: Reconnect the existing domain card; remove premature Shell draft cleanup in place. No parallel implementation is introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime, schema or external format changes.

migration: No persisted data changes; original store owns current findings and budget.
residual_risks: Real Electron generation feedback and click verification remain with the shared runner after integration.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The UI-domain join owns admission gating and stale feedback protection.
